_comment: Tier-2 for kratos poisson#: empirical resolution of the LaplacianElement HEAT_FLUX contradiction. On a P1 unit-right triangle with HEAT_FLUX=10 set on all nodes, LaplacianElement2D3N.CalculateRightHandSide returns RHS = 1.66667 = 10*area/3 on every node — the classic linear-shape-function consistent load. With HEAT_FLUX=0 the RHS is exactly 0. This conclusively shows LaplacianElement DOES assemble the HEAT_FLUX volumetric source term. The catalog claims (data/kratos_knowledge.py L1908 and src/backends/kratos/generators/poisson.py pitfall #1) that say 'does NOT assemble HEAT_FLUX' are FALSE and must be removed. Verified empirically 2026-06-01 (Kratos 10.4.2 + KratosConvectionDiffusionApplication 10.4.2). MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 doubles the nodal HEAT_FLUX to 20 while leaving the expected per-node value at the documented 10 * A / 3 = 1.666667. The printed RHS numbers move because they really come from the element assembly, so the comparison fails -- which is what makes this gate evidence rather than a restatement of its own constant. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: rhs10_node0=1.666667, rhs10_node1=1.666667, rhs10_node2=1.666667, per_node_matches_expected=True, laplacian_assembles_heat_flux=True. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/poisson_laplacian_element_assembles_heat_flux && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
